# SDLC Design Review

Use `design-reviewer` and `design-review`.

Provide:

```text
Application: <name>
Application Root: <application-root>
```

Review:

- `<application-root>/docs/sdlc/requirements.md`
- `<application-root>/docs/sdlc/architecture.md`

Write:

`<application-root>/docs/sdlc/design-review.md`

Perform an independent review. Do not edit architecture directly and do not grant human Architecture Approval.
